changelog:
sol-midweek-news v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Sol Midweek AI News Digest.
- Automatically fetches, filters, and summarizes top AI news from the past 3 days.
- Generates a Jekyll blog post every Wednesday morning with contextually briefed top 3 AI stories.
- Requires API key setup and local repository configuration.
summary: Midweek AI digest — Wednesday briefing of the 3 most significant AI stories from the past 3 days, in Sol's voice.
